key_insight: The paper presents an open-source Grafana-Prometheus monitoring framework that gives multi-center radiology studies real-time, privacy-preserving visibility into data exploration and study progress.
clinical_relevance: By helping large distributed imaging studies coordinate more efficiently, the framework may reduce manual tracking burden and improve operational transparency in research networks.
method: Aggregate monitoring metrics from distributed study sites
Visualize study status through configurable Grafana dashboards
Integrate and deploy the system in Kaapana for real-world use
evidence_signal: The framework was evaluated in the Germany-wide RACOON consortium, where it was deployed across all 38 German university clinics for study monitoring.
watch_item: Its value depends on consistent metric reporting and integration across sites, and it may not fully replace study-specific coordination workflows.
paper_title: An Open-Source Monitoring Framework for Data Exploration and Progress Tracking in Multi-Center Radiology Studies
